headline: Guiding Innovation Resources to Concentrate in Key Areas
summary: The State Council recently issued the Fifteenth Five-Year Plan for intellectual property protection and application. It sets goals and key tasks for the next five years and targets enhanced IP competitiveness by 2030.
why: Intellectual property policy shapes how innovation is protected and commercialized, which affects technology companies, licensing and foreign investors' view of China's regulatory environment.
